description: This file defines the NumberFormatter class responsible for formatting numeric values according to various patterns and formats in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for processing complex number formats, scientific notation, scaling, and localization-specific formatting.

classes.name: NumberFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting numeric values based on various number format patterns, supporting complex masks, scientific notation, and localization.

methods.name: mergeComplexNumberFormatMasks
methods.description: Merges integer and decimal masks for complex number formatting.

methods.name: processComplexNumberFormatMask
methods.description: Processes complex number format masks with block-wise substitution for formatting.

methods.name: complexNumberFormatMask
methods.description: Formats a number using complex mask logic, supporting integer and fractional parts.

methods.name: f2s
methods.description: Converts a float to a string, using scientific notation conversion if needed.

methods.name: floatStringConvertScientific
methods.description: Converts a scientific notation string to a normalized decimal string.

methods.name: formatStraightNumericValue
methods.description: Formats a numeric value based on a straightforward numeric pattern.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a value according to the specified number format pattern, handling localization, scaling, scientific notation, and mixed formats.

methods.name: makeString
methods.description: Ensures the input is returned as a string.

methods.name: pregReplace
methods.description: A helper for preg_replace that ensures a string is returned.

methods.name: padValue
methods.description: Pads a formatted numeric string to match the width specified in the format pattern, considering locale-specific separators.

methods.name: areThousandsRequired
methods.description: Determines if a thousands separator is required based on the format pattern.

methods.name: scaleThousandsMillions
methods.description: Determines the scale factor for thousands, millions, etc., based on commas in the pattern.
